# RealityRouter for LLMs and AI Agents

RealityRouter is an agent-native, utility-optimized LLM routing layer designed for programmatic automation and zero-overhead deployments.

## CLI Core Commands

Use `start_router.py` (wrapped as `reality-router`) for automation. Ensure you pass `--agent` to guarantee zero prompts and automatic configuration.

```bash
# Setup without prompts (auto-detects keys, sets up Microsoft SSO fallback)
reality-router setup --agent

# Setup programmatically with strict validation (fails on missing keys)
reality-router setup --non-interactive

# Authenticate via Device Code Flow (outputs NDJSON events)
reality-router auth --agent --json

# Check health and status of the router (outputs JSON)
reality-router status --json

# Stop background daemonized router instances gracefully
reality-router stop --json

# Diagnostics / Doctor check (exit codes: 10=env, 11=auth, 12=providers, 14=port busy)
reality-router doctor --json

# Manage model visibility
reality-router models --disable-model <id> --json
reality-router models --enable-model <id> --json
```

## Quick Installation

```bash
# Linux/macOS installation (idempotent, installs executable wrapper to ~/.local/bin)
curl -fsSL https://github.com/Lars-confi/RealityRouter/raw/main/install.sh | bash

# Windows PowerShell installation
irm https://github.com/Lars-confi/RealityRouter/raw/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

## Environment & Secrets Precedence

Precedence Chain: `CLI Flags > Environment Variables > Config File (.env) > Auto-detect > Fallbacks`.
Never expose API keys or access tokens in output or logs.
